text:
**Best all-around kit: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200W solar panel.** Its 2,073.6Wh capacity is a good fit for a van’s everyday loads, and the kit includes a folding panel so you can start charging from solar without buying one separately. The listed price is $1,199 before a discount code, but check current pricing at the [kit listing](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit). How long it lasts depends on your appliances and sun; the source estimates it can run a 12V fridge and laptop for three days or more. One caveat: charging from the vehicle’s car socket is listed at only about 96W.

If keeping weight and space down matters more, the [Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2](https://powersized.com/best/rv/) is a lighter alternative at 24.9 lb, with 1,024Wh capacity and up to 600W solar input—but the cited source doesn’t list it as a panel-included kit.
